distinct_mechanisms.transfer: A depot-role table multiplies analytical facts. Exposure-weighted and depot-weighted rates have different targets; active unreported depot prevents all-roster inference. Annualized quarterly flow levels are converted before discounting at an already quarterly rate. Frozen release and later revision are kept distinct.

A removable assertion guard also admits bool. A persistent exact-type contract is written and tested. The finite-list population variance is derived by pairwise identity, reconciled by centering, converted in squared units and bounded under explicit input rounding.

Exact predictor redundancy leaves a coefficient family and unique training projection but incompatible off-support predictions. Unequal-width histogram area and ECDF endpoint/point-mass interpretation replace the Form A scatter and ordinary unique-slope scenario.

Zero rare-event counts require an inverted binomial bound and a conditional future-run budget, with the independent replication unit stated. An equality screen selects a collider despite overlap; a separate mediated mechanism distinguishes total and supported controlled direct effects.

Fixed two-horizon forecasts differ from a monthly updating service. Nested procedure selection uses inner scores and pooled outer case weights. Rounding before versus after differencing, conditional input-level envelopes and source/byte checks are reconciled.

reasoning_and_instruction_review: All twenty tasks use methods taught in the twelve accepted Volume4 chapters or their established prerequisites; no future chapter theorem, library installation or unsupplied empirical input is required.
Logarithm values and the 500th-root approximation are supplied for the rare-event question so the declared basic-calculator conditions suffice. Exact algebraic answers are accepted.

Five domains each have four explicitly numbered five-point parts and complete solutions. Each solution has a scoring allocation summing to five; open responses specify observable criteria rather than requiring a preferred opinion.
Derivations were manually checked: pairwise population variance, variance perturbation bound, deficient-rank projection family, zero-event inversion/minimum-n inequality and monotone ratio envelope.

Units are explicit for currency, squared currency, delivery exposures, monthly demand squared losses, probability versus percentages, and percentage points. Unknown active reports are never silently set to zero.

Structural equations explicitly supply counterfactuals; the simulated event probability is distinct from omitted real-world mechanisms; held-out score distinctions are about specified prediction protocols.
The source-method routes are linked inside the closed solution block, preserving closed-notes examination intent while supporting remediation.

independent_check_evidence: Checker reads all tabular numeric exam inputs directly from the HTML. An in-memory SQLite join verifies multiplicity and an EXISTS calculation independently preserves fact totals.

Both displayed Python functions execute under compile optimization0/1; old bool acceptance and assertion removal are reproduced. Thirteen invalid inputs reject under both modes of the corrected function.

Pairwise and centered exact Fraction variance agree across48 bounded generated cases, including singleton/constant/large translations; reversal, translation and squared scaling are checked. Twenty-seven rounding perturbations satisfy the derived envelope.

Regression is recomputed by a two-by-two Gram system rather than copied centered-slope formulas; original column orthogonality, six parameter-family points and27 alternative-fit loss identities verify projection geometry.
Rare-event endpoint satisfies its probability equation and planned budget is checked at1496/1497. All four collider states and six mediator states are enumerated.
Forecasts use explicit historical prefixes. Nested scores parse the HTML case counts. Exact rational display rounding and25 numerator/denominator perturbation pairs check replication arithmetic.

Checker enforces one h2 with form-b ID, no h1, unique v04-b internal IDs, five four-part questions, twenty five-point labels, twenty scoring allocations, five solution records and twelve existing chapter links.

source_policy.retrieval: No new external source retrieval. Stable methods and scoped source claims reused from accepted v04-c01 through v04-c12; no new factual claim requiring specialist verification was introduced.
source_policy.originality: All scenarios, numerical records, question composition and solutions created for this form; no university examination or source problem copied.

limitations: This is author review supported by independent calculation routes, not external human validation or institutional certification.
The test instruments have not been empirically calibrated for difficulty or completion time; the180-minute allowance and scoring thresholds belong to the library design.
Checks address the stated finite inputs, displayed programs and structural requirements; they cannot guarantee correctness for every modified exam or economic interpretation.
No visual, mobile or print UI QA was performed. Root must integrate and independently review before acceptance.
handoff: Complete Form B ready for root review/integration. Only the three assigned Form B paths were written; no shared state, other manuscript, build output, commits or publication changed.
